skill.name: wizard
skill.description: Generates interactive Bash wizards for guided setup, migrations, and state changes, including URL opening, confirmations, environment files, and GitHub configuration.
skill.summary: Create guided Bash procedures that capture values, update environment files, and configure GitHub secrets.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Most command and device-file alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, arithmetic expansion, fixed commands, and output redirection. Confirmed risks involve intentional environment-secret handling, authenticated GitHub configuration updates, and temporary storage of environment contents. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Repository discovery can expose existing environment secrets to model context.
remediation.suggestion: Inspect variable names from example files and CI references first. Read populated environment files only after explicit user approval, and never echo values.

remediation.issue: Environment values are written without rejecting embedded newlines.
remediation.suggestion: Validate keys and reject newline or null characters in values. Use a dotenv-aware serializer and enforce restrictive file permissions.

remediation.issue: Temporary files containing environment values may remain after an interrupted write.
remediation.suggestion: Create the temporary file beside the destination with restrictive permissions, register a cleanup trap, and remove it on every failure path.

remediation.issue: GitHub secret and variable writes rely on the repository inferred by the gh CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Display the resolved repository and require confirmation before remote writes. Support an explicit repository argument for every gh mutation.

semantic_findings.title: Environment Value Injection
semantic_findings.description: write_env appends values without rejecting embedded newlines. A pasted multiline value can add or replace unintended environment assignments.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The value is written directly through printf, and Bash input can contain embedded newlines. No validation or dotenv escaping occurs before replacement.

semantic_findings.title: Unscoped GitHub Configuration Writes
semantic_findings.description: set_secret and set_var mutate the repository inferred by gh without displaying or validating it. A wrong working directory can update another repository.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both helpers invoke authenticated gh mutation commands without an explicit repository argument or repository confirmation. The target therefore depends on ambient CLI context.

content.value_statement: Manual setup and migration procedures are easy to miss or repeat incorrectly. This skill creates interactive Bash wizards with guided stages, confirmations, and value handling.
actual_capabilities: Reviews repository setup files and CI references to map required values.
Copies a reusable Bash template and authors ordered procedure stages.
Opens browser URLs through supported Windows, WSL, Linux, and macOS commands.
Captures visible or hidden input and reuses existing environment values.
Upserts environment values and configures GitHub Actions secrets or variables through gh.
Shows stage progress, remaining time, confirmations, and a closing summary.
limitations: Generated wizards require human interaction and should not run unattended.
Current web interface steps may require documentation or user confirmation.
GitHub configuration requires an installed and authenticated gh CLI.
Local secrets remain in plaintext environment files and require access controls.

use_cases.title: Standardize Project Onboarding
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable wizard that collects configuration values and guides each setup stage.

use_cases.title: Configure Third-Party Services
use_cases.description: Guide dashboard navigation, capture service credentials, and place values in approved destinations.

use_cases.title: Control One-Time Migrations
use_cases.description: Turn a state transition into ordered stages with confirmation before irreversible actions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Wizard
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Bash wizard for [procedure]. Include these stages: [stages]. Save captured values to [destination]. Ask before irreversible actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a known procedure with a short stage list.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up a Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a wizard for [service]. Open the required dashboard pages. Capture [values]. Store secrets locally and in GitHub only where required.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for third-party service configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Map Repository Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository for setup requirements. Propose ordered wizard stages and value destinations. Wait for approval before generating the script.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when setup requirements are distributed across project files.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Migration Wizard
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a wizard that moves [system] from [current state] to [target state]. Include validation, rollback guidance, confirmations, and a final completion summary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for complex transitions with irreversible or remote actions.

output_examples.input: Create a wizard for Stripe test credentials in local development and GitHub Actions.
output: A Stripe API key stage opens the test dashboard and identifies both required keys.
The secret prompt hides input, while the publishable key uses visible input.
Both values update the environment file, and the secret also updates GitHub Actions.

output_examples.input: Plan a wizard for moving an application from staging to production.
output: The plan lists preparation, data migration, verification, traffic change, and final checks.
Each irreversible stage includes a confirmation gate and clear success criteria.
Unknown provider steps are marked for documentation review before script generation.

output_examples.input: Generate a repeatable onboarding wizard from this repository.
output: The wizard maps example environment variables and CI references without exposing existing values.
It groups related actions into focused stages with progress estimates.
The handoff includes syntax validation and the command needed to start the wizard.

best_practices: Confirm the stage plan and every value destination before generating the wizard.
Use hidden input for secrets and write only credentials required by each destination.
Verify syntax statically and review every remote or irreversible action with the user.
anti_patterns: Do not invent dashboard steps when current provider documentation is unavailable.
Do not place secrets in visible prompts, logs, examples, or command arguments.
Do not run the interactive wizard end to end without the user controlling each stage.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates an interactive Bash script that guides a person through setup, migration, or state-change stages.

faq.question: Can the wizard store secrets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can capture hidden input, update an environment file, and set GitHub Actions secrets through gh.

faq.question: Does it run without human input?
faq.answer: No. The workflow opens browser pages, waits for copied values, and asks for confirmations.

faq.question: Which operating systems can open URLs?
faq.answer: The template supports common browser commands on Windows, WSL, Linux, and macOS.

faq.question: Does GitHub configuration always work?
faq.answer: No. The gh CLI must be installed, authenticated, and connected to the intended repository.

faq.question: How should generated scripts be verified?
faq.answer: Check Bash syntax, run ShellCheck when available, and trace every captured value to its approved destination.
